reply:
erms bottomed out around 0.015. Attempts to let the P-exponents float got stuck in local minima.

Best structure so far: `a*P*ln(P) + b*t + c*t^p/P + d*t^q*ln(t)/P` with fitted p≈1.93, q≈2.34. The exact law probably has a different P- or t-dependence in those two t-terms, which I could not identify.
